svg.text: A Android: ART/Kotlin; Keystore; encrypted Room; WorkManager
B iPhone: Swift; Keychain; encrypted local database; BackgroundTasks
C J2ME/WML: Restricted fields; minimal queue; only if secure transport/storage supported
Record flow: validate -> UUID/sequence -> AES-GCM encrypt -> persist -> queue
Sync flow: authenticate -> TLS -> send UUID -> server unique constraint -> ACK -> mark synced
Offline target: retain encrypted records for a 10-hour shift.
Boundary: Class C without trustworthy encryption/key storage must not hold full sensitive patient records.
Recovery: revoke device credentials, quarantine invalid keys, preserve unsynced encrypted queue.
